answer.main_body: cooling radiator panel on support legs
answer.evidence: The panel is drawn straight-on in pure front elevation: the top frame is a single 1px outline with no visible top surface (0px), and the fins and support legs are rendered directly from the front with no 3/4 top-down foreshortening.
